desc: Ideation: parity reformulation and Lagrangian DP approach.
Implement full Python solution with parity-mask Lagrangian DP: fast input, packed 8-state calc(penalty), binary search, answer conversion, and edge-case handling.
Validate on the provided samples and small random brute-force instances to catch concavity, tie-breaking, and conversion bugs.
Optimize the DP transitions aggressively (unroll masks, local variables, avoid allocations).
